architecture_authority: Football3 V3 下一代升级方案
why_not_data_ready: Transfermarkt prepared data are public through DVC/R2 but data/prep files are Git-ignored; current public snapshot cannot be backdated to historical target cutoffs.

Wikidata structured data are CC0 and expose Transfermarkt team/player identifiers, but P7223 is explicitly incomplete and current query output alone does not prove statement availability at each historical target cutoff.
OpenFootball has cutoff-addressable Git history but fixture files identify clubs by names rather than provider stable IDs; fuzzy/name-only binding is forbidden.
Combining a later stable-ID map with an earlier name-only membership snapshot would be post-cutoff identity backfill unless the equivalence itself is proven available by that target cutoff.

movement_rules.PROMOTED: same exact stable club identity is in approved lower division prior season and target top division target season
movement_rules.RELEGATED: same exact stable club identity is in target top division prior season and approved lower division target season
movement_rules.RETURNING: same exact stable club identity has earlier top-division membership, at least one intervening absence, then target top-division membership
movement_rules.STAYING: same exact stable club identity has adjacent target-top memberships

next_after_stop: Continue to the next V3 research line with free-source audit; C2 may reopen only if a legal free historical stable-ID membership source becomes cutoff-addressable or a separately authorized source decision changes.
